items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:2:1
items.html:
The expansion returned to be gathered above, etc., and it raised together with them, in their place above, etc., all seven lights: For all the aforementioned expansion was from the aspect of the bottom Hey in the Einayim, and now that the screen has been entirely refined of all the coarseness of the Guf [body] belonging to the aspect of the bottom Hey in the Einayim, they too therefore rose and departed, together with the screen and the records, to their root in the Rosh [head], in the aspect of MAN [Mayin Nukvin].
(A note in the author’s own handwriting: meaning to the GAR [first three] of Nekudim. And from here issued the coupling of Katnut [smallness] of the bottom Hey in the Einayim; but for the coupling of Gadlut [greatness] the coupling in the GAR does not suffice, since the GAR too are not corrected for Gadlut. Rather, they must raise MAN for the coupling of AB-SAG of AK, which lowers the bottom Hey from the Einayim. It follows that what he wrote — that it decreed and raised MAN, and that thereby the coupling of HB took place — is only for the sake of the descent of the bottom Hey from the Einayim, similar to the new light in Nekudim that breached the Parsa.)
And we must remember here what the ARI writes above (page 528, item 49), that these posteriors that fell to HGT are the aspect of the MAN of AVI, which ZON always raise for them until the future to come. You also know that the expansion of the three lines of KHB to HGT are the posteriors of Keter and AVI that fell to HGT (as above, page 537, the passage beginning “The light of Tifferet”). From this it follows that the records that rose, meaning the seven lights, are the MAN needed for the ZON of Atzilut of all five Partzufim, while the posteriors of Keter and AVI, which are the expansion of the three lines of KHB, are the MAN needed for the GAR of all the Partzufim of Atzilut. Remember this. Understand here, too, how ZON, which are the seven lights, raised the MAN of AVI, which are their own posteriors. For the refinement of the screen of the ZAT raised the aforementioned expansion above, to their root, to the GAR, as explained in the words of the ARI, page 528, item 49.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:2:2
items.html: In the place of Bina, for she is the mother of the children, and there is the place where pregnancy and Ibur [impregnation] take place: For the matter of the raising of MAN applies to the Sefira of Bina alone and to no other. And even the raising of MAN to Malchut is likewise only after she has been corrected with the corrections of Ima, as written in its place. The reason for this is that the entire connection of the raising of MAN comes by force of the relation of the Bina of direct light to the ZON of direct light, as above (page 501, the passage beginning “The fourth degree”). Therefore it does not apply in the rest of the Sefirot, which do not have this relation.
